research_question: After an abnormal four-hour move with futures OI buildup into the fixed 08:00 UTC Deribit option-expiry and settlement window, does a separate post-expiry price/flow reversal deliver BTC or ETH back toward the pre-expiry four-hour volume-weighted equilibrium with cost-positive expectancy?

external_mechanism.source: Bitcoin option expiration, gamma exposure, and intraday price reversals (Finance Research Letters, 2026) plus Deribit settlement specifications
reused: daily option expiries occur at 08:00 UTC
delivery price is formed from the 07:30-08:00 index TWAP
pre-expiry hedging pressure can reverse after expiration
effect should be conditioned on elevated positioning pressure rather than traded blindly
adapted: Binance futures OI buildup is an observable positioning proxy, not claimed option gamma
four-market residual move separates focal dislocation from common crypto beta
08:00-08:15 price, taker pressure and OI form a separate transition
entry, delivery-window extreme stop and pre-expiry VWAP target belong to one post-expiry auction leg
not_used: realized future option OI or gamma
non-expiry clock times selected after results

data.price_source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly and daily five-minute futures klines
data.visibility: pre-expiry state ends at 08:00 UTC; transition uses 08:00-08:15 completed bars; entry follows the 08:15 close

scenario.context: fixed daily 08:00 UTC Deribit expiration and settlement
scenario.state: abnormal focal four-hour move and residual, elevated futures OI and volume, aligned taker pressure, then continued delivery-window pressure
scenario.transition: wholly subsequent 08:00-08:15 reversal in price and taker pressure without continued old-direction OI buildup
scenario.target: quote-volume-weighted equilibrium of the 04:00-08:00 pre-expiry window
scenario.management: fixed target, structural stop or 12:15 UTC timeout; no re-entry that day
scenario.no_trade: missing positioning data, common-beta move without focal residual, no post-expiry reversal, invalid geometry or net structural R below 1.25

evaluation.same_expiry_arbitration: larger residual z times OI buildup z times net structural R, then BTC before ETH
evaluation.overlap_policy: at most one selected BTC/ETH trade for each daily expiry

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per evaluation calendar day after all scenario families share one global account

decision_contract.advance: Only this fixed expiry family passing every declared split advances to NautilusTrader bracket execution and integration with independently positive families.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune expiry time, state thresholds, confirmation, stop, target or horizon after seeing declared results.
